notes: sparknet 0.6.0 arm: the 1122 site stack with only sources.sparknet advanced 1fd6a1fb (0.5.0) -> b01f350d (0.6.0). Kernel-side only; no vLLM call-site change. 0.6.0 chains the four one-shot collectives with programmatic dependent launch (T.pdl_sync() first statement), replaces the 0.5.0 single-slot cap and PyNCCL fallback for >256 KiB sequence-parallel prefill collectives with one persistent multi-stage pipelined kernel (8 CTAs = 2/20 GB10 SMs, SPARKNET_ROCE_STAGE_BYTES 4 MiB), and pins the RoCE proxy thread to a fast core within the cpuset (commits ca59c957, e2b41c65, fb609995; release b01f350d). The 0.6.0 P2P/PP transport is unused in TP serving. Part B (next_send_buffer zero-copy API) is deliberately not in 0.6.0.
